notes: 4 CPU quota / 4 GiB cgroup includes local PostgreSQL and concurrent final regression tests. Benchmark process affinity fixed to four CPUs.
Source filesystem probe only was injected for overlay mechanics tests. Real kernel flock, processes, PostgreSQL, Arrow, DuckDB and fsync calls ran.
No guarantee of supported-filesystem/power-loss durability or cross-container mount coordination is derived from overlay runs.
Native library allocations/RSS are measured by watchdog with admitted memory/threads/spill caps; production cgroup limits still required.
Metrics current_read_bytes/written_bytes describe affected compressed files, not total device I/O. process_io_delta is separate and excludes PostgreSQL server I/O.
B02 no-op reports zero storage-operation RSS samples because it does not enter the native processing stage; it is not a zero-memory process.
